narrative: Firming Fed rate hike expectations for December support the US dollar into the week, pushing EUR/USD to close Friday at 1.0939 and setting up upside for USD/JPY from its Friday close of 159.51. The dollar's yield advantage anchors carry across G10 crosses for the Tokyo open, maintaining pressure on major pairs as Treasury yields hold near weekly highs. Near-term price action across major pairs remains anchored to central bank policy rate paths ahead of the December FOMC meeting.
